subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress transient tool error warnings

question: Should OpenClaw add a success-aware normal-chat tool-error delivery policy beyond `messages.suppressToolErrors`, and what default should protect failed writes, sends, deletes, or commands?
rationale: The remaining work changes public configuration and intentionally changes user-visible failed-side-effect safety semantics, so source inspection cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Add Explicit Delivery Policy
options.body: Add an opt-in enum with current visible warnings as the default and success-aware/off modes for hosted or group-chat operators.

options.title: Keep Existing Boolean Only
options.body: Document `messages.suppressToolErrors` as the operator-owned all-off escape hatch and close or defer the enum request.

options.title: Make It Channel-Specific
options.body: Put final-only/off policy under channel-owned configuration where team-chat operators need it most.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Delivery Policy
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in enum with current visible warnings as the default and success-aware/off modes for hosted or group-chat operators.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent warning-policy blame and merged related PRs point to this area for deciding the safety/default contract.
